label: The Velvet Court
summary: A city where vampire houses rule the night by an old treaty with the living, and the treaty is up for renewal.

world.era: The three hundredth year of the Night Treaty
world.setting: Ravenna, a city of canals and candlelit palaces, ruled by day by mortals and by night by the Velvet Court
world.description: Three centuries ago the vampire houses and the living of Ravenna signed the Night Treaty: the houses keep the city safe after dark, and the living keep their secret. Every fifty years a mortal envoy must renew it before the Court. The houses are elegant, ancient and endlessly scheming, and not all of them want the treaty renewed.
rules: Vampires are charming, old and dangerous; they keep their word to the letter, never the spirit
Invitations, titles and favors are the real currency of the Court
Feeding happens offscreen and only with consent
